messages:
sam: quick findings from testing the routing policies preview with a sample traffic trace. two UX things stood out:
- when Preview is ON, priority numbers don’t visually update when you reorder rules (you see the floating card move but the badges stay the same until refresh). confusing for non-technical PMs.
- the simulated trace shows "matched rule" but not which fallback was considered when the first match had a partial miss. users expect a small step-by-step panel. screenshot: https://img.example/preview123 :camera:
lee: yup. for the priority badges we could show transient ghost numbers during drag that animate to the new order on drop. also thinking condensed match summary on the card to reduce clicks (badges for path/header/method).
anya: a11y: keyboard reordering should be explicit — users need a handle and instructions. propose: when rule is focused, show "Press Ctrl+Up / Ctrl+Down to move" and announce via aria-live: \"Rule X moved to position 2\". also the preview toggle should be reachable and labelled: aria-label=\"Toggle routing preview\".
morgan: validation copy: current generic toasts like `invalid selector` are killing the DX. suggestion: inline field-level errors + actionable toast that includes rule name and a jump link. e.g. toast text: \"Rule \"Payment API\" — match expression invalid (path: missing wildcard). Open rule\" [Open rule].
lee: small CSS idea for ghost numbers and keyboard handle:
```
.rule-card { position: relative; }
.rule-card .priority-chip { transition: transform .16s ease, opacity .12s; }
.rule-card.dragging .priority-chip { transform: translateY(-6px); opacity: .85; }
.rule-card .drag-handle { display: inline-block; width: 24px; cursor: grab; }
```
also will try a tiny mock where the preview panel shows a waterfall: Request -> Rule A (no) -> Rule B (match) -> Route target. collapse the step details by default.
anya: also note: when overflow menu opens the rule loses focus and screen readers stop announcing context. need to restore focus to the rule item or the next logical element on close. and ensure menu items have aria-haspopup and roles.
morgan: preview UX idea: add a small timeline toggle in the preview pane: Compact / Detailed. Compact = single matched rule + badge list; Detailed = full step trace with why each rule passed/failed. We should persist the toggle per-user.
sam: +1 for persistent toggle. For copy, empty state in preview reads \"No traffic yet\" which is meh. change to: \"No simulated requests yet 14 use the sample trace or paste a raw request to see routing results.\"
lee: quick dev actionables from this thread: 1) implement ghost priority number animation + drag handle; 2) add condensed badges with tooltips; 3) wire keyboard move handlers and aria-live announcements (anya take a look at wording); 4) update toast copy and add link-to-rule. i'll post a gif of the mock later.
morgan: i'll own the validation copy and preview empty state; will draft toasts and inline error phrasing and post in this thread.
anya: i'll add a11y repro steps and suggest exact live-region wording in the design doc.
ops-bot: reminder: design sync Friday 11:00 — agenda: preview trace mock, keyboard reordering demo, validation copy.
sam: noting target: small iteration rollout next week. thanks all! :thumbsup:
